answer.algorithm: Use a dictionary or hash map to store previously encountered values and their indices.
answer.implementation: Process the array in a single pass. Calculate the complement of each value and check whether it exists in the dictionary. If found, return the two distinct indices.
answer.complexity: O(n) average time and O(n) space.
assumptions: The input contains at least one valid pair.
answer.conclusion: A hash map allows the pair to be found in O(n) average time.
